dimensions.assessment: Affects skilled nursing facilities and patients with primary immune deficiency diseases requiring specific treatments.
dimensions.evidence: patients with primary immune deficiency diseases (rare genetic disorders that impair the immune system and increase vulnerability for other infections)

dimensions.assessment: Modifies payment structures for specific medical items and services in skilled nursing facilities.
dimensions.evidence: allows for separate payment under Medicare to skilled nursing facilities for items and services that are needed to administer intravenous immune globin

dimensions.assessment: Involves separate Medicare payments for specified HCPCS codes related to immune globulin administration.

dimensions.assessment: Amends a specific section of the Social Security Act regarding skilled nursing facility services.
dimensions.evidence: Section 1888(e)(2)(A)(iii) of the Social Security Act (42 U.S.C. 1395yy(e)(2)(A)(iii)) is amended

dimensions.assessment: Establishes a permanent statutory amendment taking effect on or after October 1, 2026.
dimensions.evidence: The amendment made by subsection (a) shall apply to items and services furnished on or after October 1, 2026.

missing_information: Total estimated cost or number of patients affected is not provided in the source.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill provides separate Medicare payment to skilled nursing facilities for administering intravenous immune globulin to patients with primary immune deficiency diseases, affecting a specific patient group and care providers.
